description: Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union, publishes official energy statistics for the EU, its member states and partner countries. The energy theme page read on 2026-09-26 covers energy balances and a variety of energy topics, and the catalogue table of contents read the same day lists 126 datasets and 15 tables in 25 folders under the Energy branch of the database. The table that led here, Final energy consumption in transport by type of fuel (TEN00126), gives annual final consumption of the transport sector in thousand tonnes of oil equivalent by fuel under the SIEC classification, such as diesel, motor gasoline, blended biodiesels, jet kerosene, LPG, electricity and natural gas, for road, rail, domestic aviation, inland navigation and pipeline transport; the API showed values from 2013 to 2024 with an update on 27 August 2026. Coverage is the EU and its countries, with some partner countries. Data are free to re-use under Eurostat's copyright notice, through the data browser, the JSON-stat and SDMX dissemination API, and bulk downloads. Caveats: summary tables such as TEN00126 aggregate several modes and fuels, so detailed work needs the full energy balance datasets, and recent years may be revised. Simulation uses are demand baselines for capacity planning and energy security and resilience studies of fuel supply to transport and other sectors. Related records: data-jrc-eu-energy-atlas-supply-demand maps EU energy supply and demand, and data-eugas-supply-transmission-consumption-eu-uk covers gas flows.
